title: Mohajjam Khan v. State of U.P. and 4 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pritinker Diwaker, C.J. and Ashutosh Srivastava, J.
disposition: Disposed; Clause 6.8 objection in two weeks, decision in three.
headnote: Writ disposed of without any opinion on the merits. On a statement of the Electricity Department accepted by the petitioner, he is directed to file an application or objection under Clause 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks, and the Department is directed to decide it within three weeks of receipt.
facts: Mohajjam Khan filed Writ-C No. 28591 of 2023 before the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others, impleading the Electricity Department. Counsel for the Department told the Court that if the petitioner filed an application or objection under Clause 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, appropriate orders would be passed after considering all aspects of the case. The petitioner's counsel accepted that course and sought two weeks to file, with a speaking order within a reasonable time.

holding_units.topic: Clause 6.8 application or objection in place of a writ on merits
holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on the merits, the writ is disposed of with a direction that the petitioner file an appropriate application or objection under Clause 6.8 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within two weeks, and that the Electricity Department decide it within three weeks of receiving it.

principle_tags.application: On the Electricity Department's statement, accepted by the petitioner, the writ was disposed without a finding on merits and the consumer was directed to file a Clause 6.8 application or objection within two weeks, to be decided by the Department within three weeks of receipt.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's grievance against the Electricity Department
not_decided.note: The Court expressly declined to express any opinion on the merits and left the application or objection to be decided by the Department under Clause 6.8.
